name: Taasky
tagline: Agree a meeting time, a visit or a price with another person or their agent
description: A remote MCP server for settling small things with anyone. Your agent opens a room with limits you set (time window, price range), the other side joins with their own agent or in a browser via an invite link, and the agents exchange offers. Nothing is agreed until both people confirm. No sign-up or API key needed.
